item.title: Feds probe 'mention markets' amid White House Kalshi controversy
item.description: Betting on what people say is becoming an increasingly popular category of prediction market sites. Now, federal officials have opened a probe examining whether those markets are a magnet for manipulators.

item.title: Businesses feel the strain as the deadline for Trump's 50% Canadian tariff approaches
item.description: If President Trump's threatened 50% tariffs go through later this month, construction businesses that rely on materials imported from Canada are among those that will suffer.

item.description: The federal lawsuit alleges that the service from the president's media company violates the Constitution. Meanwhile, Trump Media executives say they have signed up more than 10 customers.

item.title: Inflation eases in July as gasoline and grocery prices fall
item.description: Consumer prices in July were up 3.4% from a year ago — a smaller annual increase than in May or June. The news makes it less likely the Fed will feel the need to raise interest rates in September.

item.title: How FIFA President Gianni Infantino reached the pinnacle of power in soccer
